title: HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB 2026 — 100M results
claims: The 2026 Kodiak 100M was held on 9–10 October 2026 at Big Bear Lake, United States.

The ITRA 100M result table lists Cody Poskin 16:46:21, Alex Proctor 17:23:05, Max Jolliffe 18:15:45, Cornelio Ciprian 18:24:44, Matthieu Saliou 18:40:09, Cody Priest 18:43:02, Cory Fleming 19:37:55, Tony Rodriguez Cruz 19:39:21, Jose Nunez 20:01:54 and Christopher Harrington 20:30:51.
The first three women in the ITRA 100M table are Nichole Abma 20:43:40, Madeline Wighardt 22:05:50 and Charlotte Saunders 22:39:31; Abma is 11th overall.
The result table gives a finisher level of 430 for the 2026 100M.
